role: Previously frozen exploratory outcomes, source-summary migration; not new reanalysis or independent replication.

evidence.analysis: 5km horizontal cell x three preselected horizontal-speed states; speed-only (not verified foraging)
evidence.interpretation: Vertical identity survives broad horizontal movement intensity adjustment.

evidence.analysis: 5km horizontal cell x preselected two speed x two turning bins; proxy not observed task
evidence.interpretation: A simple change of speed/turning-state mixture cannot account for all source-specific vertical individuality.

evidence.analysis: 2km cells x broad speed-turn; secondary structurally eligible subset, NOT replacement for failed five-panel preflight
evidence.noneligible: Eidolon_helvum (only 1/12 eligible 2km individuals; vertical outcome NOT opened)
evidence.interpretation: Residual identity after 2km place and coarse horizontal kinematic matching in four eligible panels; not exact routes/resources.

evidence.analysis: relative tracked-session early/middle/late phase x coarse kinematic, not solar/circadian or feeding time
evidence.interpretation: Three positive panels, 2023 wet-season panel does not pass; single wet panel is not a seasonal interaction test.

evidence.analysis: source independently generated HMM ARM/COM states; paired identical support
evidence.interpretation: No support for attenuation by HMM states; conditional individuality itself fails p<=0.05. NOT external positive replication.

evidence.analysis: 1km fine horizontal patch fidelity vs vertical identity across five panels
evidence.interpretation: Frozen primary FAIL; does not exclude resource response more broadly.

caution: Repeated years/analyses from the same source cohorts are dependent. Do not meta-analyze as independent species, reclassify post-hoc subgroups, or call kinematic bins measured foraging.
